p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ce94b48e.py'; code='''def transform(grid):
    # Match each framed hole pattern to a right-side object silhouette,
    # allowing rotations and reflections, then fill the holes with its color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    blocks=[]
    for top in range(0,h,4):
        if top+4 > h: break
        pts=[(r-top-1,c-1) for r in range(top+1,top+4) for c in range(1,4) if grid[r][c]==0]
        blocks.append((top,pts))
    # Extract right-hand connected components.
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(5,w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 5<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            miny=min(y for y,x in cells); minx=min(x for y,x in cells)
            comps.append((color,frozenset((y-miny,x-minx) for y,x in cells)))
    def variants(shape):
        out=set()
        for flip in (1,-1):
            for rot in range(4):
                pts=[]
                for y,x in shape:
                    x*=flip
                    for _ in range(rot): y,x=x,-y
                    pts.append((y,x))
                my=min(y for y,x in pts); mx=min(x for y,x in pts)
                out.add(frozenset((y-my,x-mx) for y,x in pts))
        return out
    result=[row[:5] for row in grid]
    unused=comps[:]
    for top,holes in blocks:
        match=next((obj for obj in unused if variants(obj[1]) & {frozenset(holes)}),None)
        if match is None:
            # Patterns may be translated within a 3x3 panel; compare coordinates as-is.
            match=next((obj for obj in unused if len(obj[1])==len(holes)),None)
        if match:
            color=match[0]; unused.remove(match)
            for y,x in holes: result[top+1+y][x+1]=color
    return result
'''; open(p,'w').write(code); print('saved',p)

    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    width=next((c for c,v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v==0),w)
    border=grid[0][0]
    cuts=[r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c]==border for c in range(width))]
    blocks=list(zip(cuts,cuts[1:]))
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(width+1,w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and width<xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            my=min(y for y,x in cells); mx=min(x for y,x in cells)
            comps.append((color,frozenset((y-my,x-mx) for y,x in cells)))
    def variants(shape):
        ans=set()
        for flip in (1,-1):
            for rot in range(4):
                pts=[]
                for y,x in shape:
                    x*=flip
                    for _ in range(rot): y,x=x,-y
                    pts.append((y,x))
                my=min(y for y,x in pts); mx=min(x for y,x in pts)
                ans.add(frozenset((y-my,x-mx) for y,x in pts))
        return ans
    out=[row[:width] for row in grid]
    unused=comps[:]
    for start,end in blocks:
        holes=[(r-start-1,c-1) for r in range(start+1,end-1) for c in range(1,width-1) if grid[r][c]==0]
        shape=frozenset(holes)
        match=next((o for o in unused if variants(o[1]) & variants(shape)),None)
        if match is None: continue
        color=match[0]; unused.remove(match)
        for y,x in holes: out[start+1+y][x+1]=color
    return out
'''; open(p,'w').write(code)
